name: Shiraishi Yukiya
source:
Born on January 26, 1990.
Member of the Tennis club. He has a gentle personality, excellent grades, and loves animals. After he started owning a dog, he became obsessed with rescuing abandoned dogs, and as such his grades gradually declined. His mother and his teachers are worried about this, but he doesn't seem to care.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
